Obtained 2026-11-12. The models are static, with no rig or animation.

Changes made by Realmkeeper, as CC BY 3.0 requires them to be indicated: converted from GLB to FBX with
Blender 5.2.1 and uniformly scaled to a real-world height (bear 1.2 m, boar 0.9 m, goat 0.9 m), using
Tools/Blender/glb2fbx.py. No other changes were made.
